# lithium iron phosphate storage

Round-trip efficiency is measured at the point of interconnection, after auxiliary loads. A community fund receives a small share of the revenue from frequency regulation services. Data from the site feeds a public dashboard that shows charging and discharging in real time. A training programme with the regional college supplies technicians for the night shift.

The battery hall is divided into fire compartments, each with its own ventilation path. The plant can black-start a nearby gas turbine, which the grid operator tests twice a year. Noise from the cooling fans stays below the limits agreed with the neighbouring village. Permitting took longer than the construction itself, a pattern seen at several sites in the region.

Insurance terms were negotiated after a review of fire suppression and thermal monitoring. Operators report that availability improved after a firmware update to the inverters. Analysts expect the levelized cost of storage to keep falling as supply chains mature. Figures from different laboratories are not directly comparable, because each lab defines a cycle differently.
